It inhabits coniferous forests of Pinus nigra, Cedrus libani libani, Juniperus excelsa, Abies cilicica in Anatolia and Pinus brutia, Pinus nigra, and Cedrus libani brevifolia Hook F. in Cyprus. We collected this subspecies additionally on Pinus brutia trunks and registered two host lichens (both from the family Parmeliaceae) in Ibradı: Pseudevernia furfuraceae and Parmelina pastillifera.
